record.paper_title: Ball-Evans approximation problem: recent progress and open problems
record.original_question: Let f ∈ W^{2,q}(Ω, R^n) with q ≥ 1 be a homeomorphism. Is there a sequence of diffeomorphisms, or a sequence of piecewise affine homeomorphisms, that converges to f in the W^{2,q} Sobolev norm?

evidence.quote: Open problem 6. Ball-Evans approximation problem for W2,q homeomorphisms: Let f ∈ W2,q(Ω, R^n), g ≥ 1, be a homeomorphism. Can we find a sequence of diffeomorphisms (or piecewise affine homeomorphisms) which approximate f in the W2,q Sobolev norm?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Omega \subset \mathbb{R}^n$ be a bounded domain, and let $q \in [1,\infty)$. Consider the second-order Sobolev space $W^{2,q}(\Omega,\mathbb{R}^n)$, consisting of mappings whose first and second weak derivatives lie in $L^q(\Omega)$, equipped with the standard norm
$$\|f\|_{W^{2,q}(\Omega,\mathbb{R}^n)} = \Big(\sum_{|\alpha|\le 2}\int_\Omega |D^\alpha f|^q\,dx\Big)^{1/q}.$$
A mapping $f:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}^n$ is called a homeomorphism if it is a continuous bijection from $\Omega$ onto $f(\Omega)$ whose inverse is continuous. A piecewise affine homeomorphism is a homeomorphism that is affine on each simplex of some locally finite triangulation of $\Omega$.

Suppose $f \in W^{2,q}(\Omega,\mathbb{R}^n)$ is a homeomorphism onto its image. Determine whether there always exists a sequence $\{f_k\}_{k\in\mathbb{N}}$ of either smooth diffeomorphisms or piecewise affine homeomorphisms with $f_k:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}^n$ (with $f_k = f$ on $\partial\Omega$ in a suitable trace sense) such that
$$\|f_k - f\|_{W^{2,q}(\Omega,\mathbb{R}^n)} \longrightarrow 0 \quad \text{as } k\to\infty.$$
artifact.status_search_result: The second-order Ball-Evans approximation problem for $W^{2,q}$ homeomorphisms is widely regarded as open, even in the planar case $n=2$. Recent surveys and works on the Ball-Evans approximation problem explicitly list it as an open problem, noting that the second-order case is substantially harder than the well-studied $W^{1,p}$ case (resolved in the plane by Iwaniec-Kovalev-Onninen and Hencl-Pratelli). Only partial planar results exist (e.g., approximation of $W^{2,1}$ planar homeomorphisms by piecewise quadratic homeomorphisms).

status_evidence.snippet: Planar W^{2,1} homeomorphisms approximated by piecewise quadratic homeomorphisms and diffeomorphisms.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results exist in the planar second-order case, indicating the general problem is not yet resolved.

status_evidence.title: Diffeomorphic Approximation of Sobolev Homeomorphisms
status_evidence.claim: First-order case is settled, contrasting with the still-open second-order case.
